key_phrases: structural increase in underlying semiconductor demand
technology leadership will enable TSMC to capture the strong demand
50% and higher gross margin is achievable
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is strongly positive, driven by the structural growth in 5G and HPC. Management shows high confidence in their technology leadership (N3/N2) and ability to maintain margins above 50% despite rising depreciation. Demand is described as robust, though with some short-term supply chain volatility and inventory buildup in certain sectors. The company is aggressively investing (high CapEx) to stay ahead of the curve, particularly in advanced nodes. While there is some caution regarding potential inventory corrections and cost complexities of N3, the core message is one of dominance and growth. QA was direct, though management carefully avoided specific pricing or competitor-related details.
